extraction.placeName: Stadion Rummelsburg (Fußballspiel Sparta Lichtenberg – BFC Dynamo)
extraction.summaryEn: Football fans of BFC Dynamo lit pyrotechnics outside a stadium in Rummelsburg and attacked police with bottles, firecrackers and punches, with several injuries and criminal complaints including for Nazi salutes. Later, eleven people in a Weitlingstraße bar were reported chanting unconstitutional slogans.
